children: Cross Timbers Royalty Trust (CRT) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 18, 2026.

On September 18, 2026, the Registrant issued a news release announcing its monthly cash distribution to unitholders of record on September 30, 2026. A copy of the news release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The information in this Current Report, including the news release attached hereto, is being furnished pursuant to Item 2.02 of Form 8-K and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to liabilities of that Section.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/881787/000119312526395258/crt_8-k_2609_distributio.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/881787/000119312526395258/0001193125-26-395258-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
